description: Ship a per-scenario severity-rollup widget honoring the ui-health WidgetDeclaration contract (slot INLINE) so other surfaces can embed a security posture badge.

requirements.title: Security posture badge widget
requirements.description: An embeddable widget must declare itself via the JSDoc @vrooliWidget contract (slot INLINE) and render a severity rollup, top findings, and last-scan time for a given scenario.

validation.notes: The widget exposes a valid WidgetDeclaration discoverable by ui-health.
The badge renders a severity rollup and last-scan time for a scenario with findings.
